title: Ranked Trie Autocomplete
instructions:
Implement a weighted trie across `trie_nodes.py` and `autocomplete.py`.

In `trie_nodes.py`, implement `normalize_word(word: str, allow_empty: bool = False) -> str`.
Accept ASCII letters A-Z/a-z only and return lowercase. Empty input is valid only when
allow_empty is True. Invalid strings and non-string values raise `ValueError`. No stripping
or punctuation handling is performed. This module should also hold the internal trie node
representation, which is your implementation choice; it is not a separately tested API.

In `autocomplete.py`, implement `Trie()` with these methods:
- `add(word: str, weight: int = 1) -> int`: normalize word (nonempty), require positive
  integer weight excluding bool, otherwise `ValueError` without changing existing entries.
  Insert the word or add weight to its existing score, returning the new total score.
- `remove(word: str) -> bool`: normalize word (nonempty), remove its entire entry regardless
  of score, return True if it existed, False otherwise. Longer words sharing that prefix
  must survive. Re-adding a removed word starts from the new weight.
- `contains(word: str) -> bool`: normalize word (nonempty); True only for a stored complete
  word, not merely a prefix.
- `prefix_search(prefix: str) -> list[str]`: normalize prefix, allowing empty. Return all
  stored words beginning with it in ascending alphabetical order. Include the prefix itself
  if it is a stored word. Empty prefix returns all words. Missing prefixes return [].
- `autocomplete(prefix: str, limit: int = 5) -> list[tuple[str, int]]`: same normalization;
  require nonnegative integer limit excluding bool, else `ValueError`. Return at most limit
  matching (word, total_score) pairs, ordered by descending score then ascending word.
  Validate prefix even when limit is zero. Empty prefix searches the whole trie.
All methods are case-insensitive. Results use normalized lowercase words. Invalid word/prefix
inputs raise `ValueError` in every method. Returned lists must be independent of trie state.
Use only these two modules; no external storage or dependencies are needed.

## Files
- `trie_nodes.py`
- `autocomplete.py`
